entries.finding: Each rs6923761 A (Ser168) allele was associated with 0.08 percentage points smaller HbA1c reduction at six months on pooled GLP-1 RAs, not a weight effect or a semaglutide-specific result. A study of 210 oral semaglutide users found no significant association.

sources.title: Pharmacogenomics of GLP-1 receptor agonists: a genome-wide analysis of observational data and large randomised controlled trials.
Influence of GLP1 receptor rs6923761 and rs761387 genetic variants on oral semaglutide response in patients with type 2 diabetes.

entries.limits: The pooled study included 4,571 people with type 2 diabetes and did not test semaglutide specifically or measure weight. Oral semaglutide non-replication: no significant HbA1c, BMI or blood-pressure association in 210 people. Tirzepatide-specific response was not established. Research only; no CPIC guideline exists for GLP-1 RAs. Most response variation is non-genetic. No dosing or drug-choice inference.
